title: Blooming Flower Animation with HTML, CSS & JavaScript | Click to Bloom Effect
description:
In this tutorial, we build a beautiful interactive blooming flower using pure HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript.

You’ll learn how to:

🌸 Create realistic petals with CSS gradients and transforms

🌿 Animate leaves and stem using keyframes

✨ Control the bloom state with CSS variables

🖱️ Add click and keyboard interaction with JavaScript

🌼 Generate floating pollen particles for a magical effect

This project is perfect for:

• Front-end developers

• CSS animation lovers

• UI motion design practice

• JavaScript beginners who want real visual results

No libraries. No frameworks. Just clean, modern HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JS.
